All 552 unit tests pass. Integration failures pre-exist, missing `typer` module, unrelated.

Root cause and fix: `MemoryStore.decisions()` at `src/verityai/memory/store.py:162` filtered by raw `status` field only — never followed `supersedes` chain despite docstring claim. `supersede()` set `replacement.supersedes` but never touched old record (append-only, correctly), so old decision stayed `ACTIVE` forever. Consequence: `consistency/check.py`'s `check_decision_resurfacing` (filters `status in (REJECTED, SUPERSEDED)`) never caught superseded decisions being re-proposed.

Fix: `decisions()` now computes `superseded_ids` from all `supersedes` targets in the log and reclassifies matching `ACTIVE` records to `SUPERSEDED` in-memory on read — matches docstring, no disk rewrite. Added regression tests in both files; all pass.
